issues.description: Production rates are placeholders and not calibrated; louvered doors at QL-5 remain high risk.
issues.suggested_fix: Add calibration data and optionally implement a not-to-exceed or authorization threshold pattern for louvered QL-5.

issues.description: Materials systems are generic (no product SKUs); acceptable for early phase but should map to Material DB later.
issues.suggested_fix: Add Material DB references once available; maintain system IDs as stable interface.

issues.description: Glass protection includes both masking and cut-in tasks; applicability gating should be enforced by configuration selection logic at runtime/import.
issues.suggested_fix: Ensure estimator selection rules choose one strategy (mask_lites OR cut_in) per French door variant.

summary: Structure is coherent and modular with per-side counting and quality rounds. Draft is usable for workflow validation but not approved for production estimating.
review_notes: Per-side door counting is correctly modeled as ITM_DOOR_SIDE EA.
Edge burn and profile sanding are explicit tasks (good).
Louvers need special handling economically; consider explicit governance rule.
